heroHeadline: ARTEMIS II ASTRONAUT CHRISTINA KOCH ASSUMES NEW NASA LEADERSHIP ROLE
heroSubtitle: Oct 14: Artemis II crew member Christina Koch has taken on a new NASA role, raising questions about implications for the mission crew lineup. Oct 12: NASA publicly released over 800GB of Artemis II lunar science data.
footerNote: Data sourced from NASA.gov, OIG Reports, SpaceNews, Ars Technica, Congressional appropriations. Tier 1: NASA/ESA/Official. Tier 2: SpaceNews/Ars Technica/Reuters. Tier 3: Planetary Society/AIAA.
